Path: business objects and records — a control writes only where it can | 缺项 (the Add reaction button on activity rows writes `sys_comment` by an activity id) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction A: offer the reaction control only on comment rows

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` (the `ReactionPicker` render, with no item-kind gate) ⇒ `domain:ui`, a published library.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T04:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** Every record page's discussion panel offers a control on activity rows that cannot work. When used, it sends a `sys_comment` write keyed by a `sys_activity` id. That write either fails, or, if an id collides, lands on an unrelated comment. It is a wrong write door on an ordinary click, the same p2 as objectui#11019 in the same panel.

**Direction: A, as the card leans.**
- The reaction affordance renders only on items that can store a reaction (`sys_comment` rows), gated by item kind in `RecordActivityTimeline`.
- B alone would still offer a control that cannot work. A handler guard beside A is optional, and ⛔ it is never the only fix.
- **Pins:** an activity row shows no Add reaction button, and a comment row does. No `sys_comment` write is ever keyed by an activity id.
- **Not serial.** PR objectui#11034 (objectui#11019) merged at 2026-09-29T03:29Z.

Claim: PM loop round 17 · an opus-only card while the review tier is unavailable
Session: `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`
Account: `os-steve` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`: the `ReactionPicker` (and any existing-reaction display that invites a click) renders only on items that can store a reaction, i.e. `sys_comment` rows, gated by item kind.
- Optionally, a handler guard in `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` beside the gate: ⛔ never as the only fix.
- Pins: an activity row shows no Add reaction button, and a comment row does. No `sys_comment` write is ever keyed by an activity id.
- A changeset.

⛔ No change to how comment reactions are stored (that was objectui#11019, PR objectui#11034), and no server change.
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, objectstack `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12692` at `81137630`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: a render gate on an existing control, by the item kind the feed already carries; no published type, schema key, spec row or documented contract moves.
Thread-read: 5883926878
Dispatch note: under the maintainer's 「当前没有fable，你可以派 opus 卡」 (this seat's chat, 2026-09-29T01:00Z), this card needs no review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The seat verifies the changeset prose itself at the ACCEPT.
Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-29T05:02Z at objectui `origin/main`. PR objectui#11034 (objectui#11019, the same panel) merged 2026-09-29T03:29Z. The open PRs objectui#11046, #11045, #11033, #10278 and #5400 touch neither `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` nor `RecordDetailView.tsx`.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#11048 (`Fixes #11035`) · `domain:ui` seat #1 · 2026-09-29T05:51Z

`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk` (`os-steve`), the claiming seat (claim `5883986691`). Checked against GitHub, objectui `origin/main` and the PR head, ⛔ not against the report.

**Checklist**
- **Shape.** Draft → `main`. The body opens `Fixes #11035`, then `Clause-②: no` at line start. PR assignee `os-steve`.
- **Scope.** 6 files, +464 / −12. Direction A as triage ruled (`5883926878`):
  - `RecordActivityTimeline` offers reactions only where `canStoreReaction(item)` holds, i.e. `item.type === 'comment'`, the one feed kind built from `sys_comment` rows. Any other row gets no Add reaction button, and its chips render unclickable.
  - The optional guard: `RecordDetailView.handleToggleReaction` returns without a write when the id's feed row is not a comment. It sits beside the render gate, not instead of it.
  - Two pin files, four lines of `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`, and a `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- **Governed-surface predicate.** 6 paths: `NOT governed`.
- **Checks on head `8bc1d5040`.** 43 check-runs: 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failure, `Spec Main Shape Gate` included. `mergeable_state` reads `clean`.
- **Commits.** One, trailers model-free.
- **Pins and legs.**
  - 27 tests. One case per `sys_activity` type that reaches a panel, and one per spec feed kind other than `comment`. The real record page never issues a `sys_comment` update keyed by an activity id.
  - The red leg on `main` fails 25 of 27.
  - Ablations: removing the render gate reds 23. Removing the guard reds exactly its probe pin, so each layer is pinned on its own.

**Prose, verified by the seat against the diff** (no review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed: `Clause-②: no`, dispatched under the maintainer's 「当前没有fable，你可以派 opus 卡」):
- The changeset's four paragraphs match the code line for line: the comment-only gate, unclickable chips on other rows, the comment row unchanged, and the guard writing nothing.
- The four docs lines correct a sentence the change would have made false ("Toggle emoji reactions on any feed item"). They now say what the code does: comment rows only, chips elsewhere unclickable, `onToggleReaction` called only for a comment row. The prose edit makes the docs true of the behaviour, and it is recorded here because `content/docs` is a surface the seat reads line by line.

**Observations recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes, not filed:**
- `@object-ui/types`' `RecordActivityComponentProps.enableReactions` docblock still says "on activities". That is polish.
- `RecordDetailView`'s feed merge keys the `sys_comment` and `sys_activity` reads by id alone, so a shared id would share a row. This is read-only and not measured.

**Landing**: not governed, green, `Clause-②: no` ⇒ `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable` through the relay, after this record reads back. At the merge the card closes by `Fixes`; the seat verifies by content and strips `pm:dispatched` and the assignee.
